channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mark Cuban | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mark Cuban from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dan Gilbert on Mark Cuban, David Stern
item.description:
Dan Gilbert:

“David Stern was a phenomenal commissioner for 30 years. He built that league. Buthe too, he used to pick on Mark Cuban, he used to pick on me, he picked on the new guys.”

Dan Gilbert on Mark Cuban, David Stern, Jun 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on LeBron James, Mark Cuban, Anthony Davis, Rob Pelinka, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Jeanie Buss on how the Luka Doncic trade went down:

“Dallas wanted Anthony Davis and he was on our team. Conversations started but it was important they remained private….Those conversations started in the beginning of January…Rob Pelinka was able to pull it off all without it leaking to the media because I think Mark Cuban would’ve jumped in front of a train to keep it from happening. Nobody knew including Luka, Anthony Davis, and LeBron James. We had a game in New York that night, the coach knew this was going to happen but he still had to coach the game. It wasn’t a distraction”

Jeanie Buss on LeBron James, Mark Cuban, Anthony Davis, Rob Pelinka, Luka Doncic, May 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Mark Cuban, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Jason Kidd on if he reached out to Luka Doncic after Mark Cuban’s comments:

“Understand that Luka is in the other side. He’s trying to kick our butt. We’re trying to kick his butt. Understand that there’s not going to be a phone call to Luka.”

Jason Kidd on Mark Cuban, Luka Doncic, Apr 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Jason Kidd on if he felt blindsided by Mark Cubans claim that he knew about the Luka trade:

“When I found out about it, I just looked at it as this is just Cuban. And he has a right to his opinion, but I’m here to tell you the truth.”

Jason Kidd on Mark Cuban, Apr 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Charlie Villanueva on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Charlie Villanueva on Mark Cuban:

“He’s A1. He hanging out with us. He on the flights. He like, ‘Y’all want to do something? Let’s go. We out.’Like, we—like, it almost felt a little weird— Like, I’m going to hang out with my boss? That’s a little—you know what I mean? That’s a little weird. But it was cool, man. He was A1, man. Took care of his players, and just how they did everything, man—just, you know, top-notch organization.”

Charlie Villanueva on Mark Cuban, Mar 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Adam Silver on Mark Cuban, Patrick Dumont
item.description:
“I think the situation was very different in Dallas. There was a clear change in control of the franchise to Patrick Dumont and his family. Any decision as to what Mark's role would be in basketball operations was a function of an arrangement to be made between Mark Cuban and Patrick. The ultimate governance was absolutely clear, as presented to our board, that the last word on any basketball activities or any significant decision for the franchise would be made by Patrick. I think Mark has acknowledged that, as I've obviously seen some of his commentary on the trade.”

Adam Silver on Mark Cuban, Patrick Dumont, Mar 28, 2025. Source: marcstein.substack.com.

item.title: Rick Brunson on Mark Cuban
item.description:
“Yo man, I know what [Cuban is] doing. He's going to come to New York and say, 'Here goes a max deal,'”

Rick Brunson on Mark Cuban, Mar 24, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Adam Silver on Mark Cuban, Patrick Dumont
item.description:
“I’ve talked to Mark [Cuban] and have run into him several times over the course of the last few months and have begun much more involved with Patrick Dumont as the governor of the team,”

Adam Silver on Mark Cuban, Patrick Dumont, Jun 13, 2024. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Jerry Jones on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Jerry Jones:

“As far as the decision Mark [Cuban] made, I’ll go along with his decisions anytime. He knows how to make good ones and he’s made them. He’s got a great story of his career and what he’s done and he didn’t do that being dumb. I promise you, this will be in the best interest, in my mind, of sports and the Mavericks fans.”

Jerry Jones on Mark Cuban, Dec 1, 2023. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Haralabos Voulgaris on Mark Cuban
item.description:
“I sent [Cuban] an email where I was like, 'Hey, look, I'm just trying to fit in. I appreciate the opportunity. I don't want to ruffle any feathers,'”

Haralabos Voulgaris on Mark Cuban, Oct 22, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Mark Cuban
item.description:
“I just have such great respect for [Mavs owner Mark Cuban] and everyone there, and I'm fortunate to move on to another great opportunity.”

Rick Carlisle on Mark Cuban, Jun 24, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jay Williams on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Williams continued, noting that

“New York isn’t the only option.“But I will say there’s a lot of rumblings, and [Mavericks owner] Mark Cuban needs to put water on that fire.”

Jay Williams on Mark Cuban, Jun 18, 2021. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Mark Cuban
item.description:
However, Porzingis denied that’s the case and noted that he’s never had any issues with his teammates so far in his career.

“I’ve never had any problems with my teammates off the court, I’ve always gotten along very well with them. I don’t know what Cuban was talking about. I try to be as professional as possible, do what I have to do and be a soldier for the team,”

Kristaps Porzingis on Mark Cuban, May 11, 2021. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Mark Cuban, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Mark Medina:Rick Carlisle on Luka Doncic criticizing the play-in tournament & Mark Cuban expressing concerns about it to @Tim MacMahon:

“Luka & Mark hade made strong statement about it. I don't see a need for a third.”

Rick Carlisle on Mark Cuban, Luka Doncic, Apr 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Jason Terry on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Terry says in the interview.

“My wife’s looking at my phone, like, ‘Excuse me, it’s 2 a.m., who’s texting?’ And it said, ‘Meet at the jet.’ And I said, ‘It’s Mark [Cuban].’Terry’s wife told him he’d better hurry up and meet with Cuban, because the situation “must be urgent”

Jason Terry on Mark Cuban, Jul 4, 2020. Source: CNBC.

item.title: Cynthia Marshall on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Cynthia Marshall:

“It is criminal that, in 2020, we have kids who can’t eat because school is out. They don’t have access to technology. That’s crazy to me. Not everybody can go to a grocery store. These are the things that are top of mind for us. My boss (Mark Cuban) is out there advocating for small businesses and people who are losing their jobs. Even though we’re not playing basketball, we’re playing the game of life with people right now. We don’t just play here. We live here, too. We’re part of something bigger and now we get to make it better.”

Cynthia Marshall on Mark Cuban, Apr 24, 2020. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Josh Howard on Mark Cuban
item.description:
“Cuban definitely supports what I’m doing and it’s a blessing for me to have people that really care about what I do out here. Cuban has never lied to me. I respect a man like that.”

Josh Howard on Mark Cuban, Aug 29, 2019. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Yogi Ferrell on Mark Cuban
item.description:
He said there are no hard feelings on either side, and that the decision revolved around his style of play.

“Mark Cuban, he was the one that gave me my first opportunity in the league,”

Yogi Ferrell on Mark Cuban, Jul 25, 2018. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Dirk on Cuban’s tanking comments:

“I'll never stand for losing on purpose. That's not who I am.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Mark Cuban, Feb 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @Baxter.

item.title: Derek Harper on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Dwain Price:Derek Harper on his jersey being retired:

“I want to take this opportunity to thank Mark Cuban. Because of you Mark, I have a championship ring.”

Derek Harper on Mark Cuban, Jan 7, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Tim Donaghy on Mark Cuban
item.description:
“And he hated Mark Cuban’s guts. He absolutely hated Mark Cuban.“He’s programming and training these referees to look for certain things that definitely put Miami at an advantage. Ed Rush used to tell us that Mark Cuban was someone that created a lot of extra work for us, constantly calling the league office and that really just got everyone to start to dislike Cuban.”

Tim Donaghy on Mark Cuban, Nov 18, 2017. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Draymond Green on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“When you look at Mark Cuban, for instance, with the whole equity thing, we can all own equity and that’s fine. But Mark Cuban would never know or understand how it feels for me, a young black man and turn on the TV and see what happened in Charlottesville.”

Draymond Green on Mark Cuban, Nov 16, 2017. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Andre Iguodala on Mark Cuban:

“I understand because he's removed himself so far from the other incident that owners have gotten themselves in trouble with references to American historical events. So, I understand that he has to defend himself, but at the same time, he's not able to understand what it's like to be an African-American and certain terms being thrown around and how we feel about them.”

Andre Iguodala on Mark Cuban, Nov 4, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Devin Harris on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Devin Harris:

“Teammates reached out. A couple of guys came to see me in the hospital. @Mark Cuban was there with me the whole time.”

Devin Harris on Mark Cuban, Oct 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Eddie Sefko:Dirk Nowitzki on his $5M contract:

“It was my time to show again that I love being here. I gave him (Cuban) a little bit of a deal maybe.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Mark Cuban, Aug 3, 2017. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Mark Cuban, Donnie Nelson
item.description:
“But with Yogi being an Indiana guy, we thought we might have a chance. Donnie and I talked about it, and Donnie brought it to [Cuban] and he’s like, ‘Sure, the Indiana guy gets the tie.’”

Rick Carlisle on Mark Cuban, Donnie Nelson, Mar 12, 2017. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Donnie Nelson:

“We have daily conversations with pretty much everyone in the league and you're always talking about the possibility. That's kind of our job. There isn't a single person that doesn't come up in a discussion during the course of the season. So again, you're always weighing those and measuring those opportunities. When something comes up you have to take a peak at it and if something comes up, one thing Mark Cuban isn't is trigger shy.”

Donnie Nelson on Mark Cuban, Feb 17, 2017. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle on @Mark Cuban getting a celeb game triple-double:

“I wouldn't have said Trump's odds of being president was very good either.”

Rick Carlisle on Mark Cuban, Feb 9, 2017. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Mark Cuban
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on the speculation about Mark Cuban being nominated for vice president:

“When all that stuff was being talked about, I was curious to see who was going to run with it. I can certainly see the appeal of why someone would want Mark. He's extremely visible, extremely intelligent, business-savvy. He understands the media. I think he has a great grasp on a lot of things in the world including politics. I was a little uncertain if anybody had enough money to pay him to do it. Those jobs don't pay a lot.”

Rick Carlisle on Mark Cuban, Jun 4, 2016. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Kevin Durant, Mark Cuban
item.description:
Royce Young:Russell Westbrook on Kevin Durant sticking up for him about Mark Cuban:

“He's always going to have my back and I'm always going to have his.”

Russell Westbrook on Kevin Durant, Mark Cuban, Apr 27, 2016. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.
